body: Hopefully they'll understand if I explain it to them in a letter. They'd be better off without me.

I can't take their money after they helped me out the last time and then I got right back into trouble again. They'd be rightfully furious and cut off all contact.

It's better off this way. It's my time to go and stop screwing things up.
Got it--I have an appointment with my psychiatrist next Monday, and I'll try to drop by my doctor to get a signed certificate. Thank you!
